It becomes conditionally resolvable because cycle-002-crm-snapshot.json is now inside the official chain and clearly anchors an aggregated CRM snapshot, which is enough to sustain snapshot-bound documentary progression of R2. It is not enough to claim a current live CRM read-only anchor without ambiguity.

session_write_decision.pattern_observed: The approved chain moved R2 onto manual-orchestrated documentary execution and explicitly prohibited runner stateful paths in 13A, indicating that agent-session side effects remain an operational concern rather than an accepted default.
session_write_decision.scope_boundary: For documentary or zero-write-sensitive phases, no stateful agent path should be presumed acceptable. Any future phase that may write session metadata outside workspace-integration must be explicitly tolerated by contract or avoided.
conditions: Prefer manual-orchestrated documentary production when zero-write cleanliness matters.
Do not treat session-file side effects as acceptable by default.
If a future phase proposes agent-assisted execution, the contract must state whether ~/.openclaw/agents session writes are tolerated or blocking.
session_write_decision.review_trigger: Review again before any future phase that proposes agent execution, embedded/local behavior, or another path likely to persist session state.
